purpose: Falsify or support the hypothesis that unusually favorable late passive maker bids in Kalshi weather markets can receive conservatively provable fills often enough, and that the filled subset can retain positive conditional net economics after adverse selection, fees and friction.

scope.eligible_market_rule: Include only weather contracts for which exact contract rules, close time, settlement source/finality semantics, full required point-in-time execution evidence and final authoritative settlement can be archived. Unknown semantics fail closed.
scope.correlated_quotes_rule: All virtual quotes and strike/bucket contracts tied to the same settlement event are clustered and must not be treated as independent events.

virtual_order_grid.side_rule: Use only the side frozen by candidate_selection_rule from the authoritative T-30m snapshot; no later side or ticker switching is permitted.

fill_model_primary.name: CONSERVATIVE_PRICE_TIME_QUEUE
fill_model_primary.queue_rule: At virtual-order creation, join behind all displayed quantity already resting at the exact price. Price touch alone never proves a fill.
fill_model_primary.depletion_credit: Credit queue depletion only from point-in-time public execution evidence whose semantics are sufficient to distinguish executed quantity from cancellations or unrelated book changes. Cancellations receive zero fill credit.
fill_model_primary.partial_fill_rule: Credit only the quantity proven to have executed after provable queue-ahead depletion; all remaining quantity stays unfilled.
fill_model_primary.sequence_gap_rule: Any unresolved sequence gap affecting an active virtual order makes its subsequent fill state UNPROVEN_FILL.
fill_model_primary.reconnect_rule: Reconnect or resubscription ambiguity affecting queue continuity invalidates the active queue state unless continuity is deterministically re-established from an authoritative snapshot/sequence contract.
fill_model_primary.restart_rule: Any active virtual order spanning a collector restart is labelled UNPROVEN_RESTART and excluded from PRIMARY fill economics unless continuity is deterministically proven.
fill_model_primary.optimistic_sensitivity: May be reported separately, but must never be mixed into PRIMARY results.

required: orderbook timestamped snapshots and relevant L2 depth
ordered deltas/sequence identifiers when supplied by the feed
public trades/execution evidence with documented semantics
fee schedule applicable at virtual-order time
virtual-order creation timestamp and frozen grid coordinates
final authoritative settlement outcome and retrieval timestamp

adverse_selection.interpretation: Favorable fills may be toxic/informed flow; PRIMARY analysis must pair fill proof with markouts and final settlement rather than treating fill occurrence as positive evidence.

economics.conditional_ev_definition: realized settlement payout per proven filled contract minus executed virtual price minus point-in-time applicable fees/friction

evaluation_window.start_rule: The first eligible settlement event observed strictly after a separate ACTIVATION record is committed following all mandatory deathchecks.
evaluation_window.stop_rule: Stop at the earlier of 100 eligible settlement events or 7 full calendar days after activation. Do not extend automatically because results or sample size are inconvenient.
evaluation_window.if_insufficient_data: Report INSUFFICIENT_DATA or NO_PROVEN_EDGE; do not change the frozen grid or silently extend the window.

metrics.multiple_testing_rule: Grid cells and reporting slices are descriptive within this pilot; the contract-side pair is frozen once per settlement event by candidate_selection_rule. Do not select a profitable cell or alternate contract/side post hoc as a new proven strategy. Any post-hoc survivor becomes a new hypothesis requiring fresh untouched prospective data.

miami_case.market_context: Miami hourly temperature, 76F or above, NO side
miami_case.role: proof-of-mechanism regression fixture only; never validation evidence

mandatory_deathchecks_before_activation.pass_condition: Cancellation-only/touch-without-execution fixtures cannot become PRIMARY fills, and ambiguous queue depletion becomes UNPROVEN_FILL.

The settlement event, ticker and side are deterministically frozen from the authoritative T-30m snapshot using candidate_selection_rule, with lexical tie-break and fail-closed ambiguity handling; price, size and T-minus grid are preregistered; later settlement, markout, weather or price information cannot alter selection or placement.
The experiment has no enabled code path for order placement/cancel/amend, wallet/fund movement, paid API, cloud/VPS or paid OpenAI API use; any uncertainty fails closed.

required: Miami regression fixture reproduces 5 at 89 cents -> +$0.55 without being counted as prospective evidence
raw archive and sequence/reconnect ambiguity handling are reproducible

revision.rationale: Freeze a deterministic pre-close settlement-event, contract and side selection rule so DC2_NO_HINDSIGHT is falsifiable and cannot depend on later outcome information.

candidate_selection_rule.snapshot_rule: Use the first authoritative point-in-time order-book snapshot at or after T-30m and strictly before market close. If that snapshot or exact close/rule semantics is unavailable, exclude the settlement event.
candidate_selection_rule.settlement_event_rule: For each settlement event, evaluate all otherwise eligible binary weather contracts visible in the frozen T-30m snapshot and select at most one contract-side pair.
candidate_selection_rule.side_rule: For each contract, compare executable best asks for YES and NO in the frozen T-30m snapshot. A side is eligible only if its executable best ask is between 97 and 99 cents inclusive. If neither side qualifies, exclude that contract. If both qualify or the feed is ambiguous, exclude it.
candidate_selection_rule.contract_rule: Within a settlement event, choose the eligible contract-side pair with the highest executable best ask; break an exact tie by lexicographically smallest ticker. Freeze that ticker and side for the full event.
candidate_selection_rule.no_switching_rule: After the T-30m selection, never switch ticker or side because of later price moves, weather observations, markouts or settlement information.
candidate_selection_rule.order_grid_rule: Apply only the preregistered maker_bid_cents and t_minus_minutes grid to the frozen side. Missing or late evidence fails closed; unfilled virtual orders remain zero PnL.
candidate_selection_rule.independence_rule: All grid observations for the selected contract-side remain one correlated settlement-event cluster and are not independent trials.
